objective: Capture the hook payloads cursor-agent sends once and replay them offline through the real gates, so a test records gate by gate whether each gate blocks under Cursor, and make the Cursor adapter and docs state that tested coverage.
why: ac2-1 and ac2-2 are not-verified. docs/harnesses/cursor.md line 15 says cursor-agent ignores hooks.json, while the Cursor CLI changelog (v2026.08.11) and its third-party-hooks page say Claude settings.json hooks load. A hook that fires is not a hook that blocks: Cursor names its tools Shell and Write, and require-active-ticket.sh line 302 allows a non-Bash call with no file_path. No recorded test settles which gates block. o3 and o7 depend on knowing what Cursor enforces.

include: A capture hook that logs the raw stdin of every hook event

One manual cursor-agent -p --trust run in a sandbox fork that triggers each gate (ticket-first on write and edit; dispatch-bash on shell; leak; merge gate) with a gh stub on PATH so no real PR can merge
The captured payloads committed with the Cursor CLI version and the third-party-hooks setting and the date
An offline test that replays each payload through the real hooks and asserts the exit code and decision (block or allow) and runs in CI without Cursor credentials

A coverage table in docs/harnesses/ plus matching updates to docs/harnesses/cursor.md and docs/harnesses/README.md and docs/cursor-adapter.md and the setup and handover skills and the bin/install-cursor-adapter.sh line 161 message
A ticket or a documented reason for each gate that does not block
exclude: Code changes that add coverage for gates that do not block (each gets its own ticket)
